text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Tax debts will lapse after three years, according to a bill to be delivered to the Finance Ministry in July.
- A poll by the newspaper revealed that 86.9 percent of Portuguese believe that unmarried couples should have the same rights as married ones.
- In a meeting between Finance Minister Antonio Sousa Franco and Economy Minister Augusto Mateus it was decided that an increase in the fuel tax would not cause an increase in fuel prices.
- Portuguese indicators on education are the lowest in Europe, a UNESCO report says.
- The Finance Ministry estimates there will be a 40 billion escudos annual loss in tax revenues if the oil products tax is not increased.
- The paper holding Inapa sold its five percent stake in porcelain company Vista Alegre, ending an association of several years.
